summary.text: On Ravnica, the guild leaders gather at Karlov Manor, where Zegana is found dead and the great detective Alquist Proft takes up the case alongside Kaya, who is called to lead the investigation after Teysa is murdered too.
The killers turn out to be people who remember nothing, and Proft traces the killings to a flower grown from the roots of Vitu-Ghazi and names Trostani as the mastermind.
Oba admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it, drawing on the Worldsoul itself, until Kaya refuses to execute her and Oba is bound, leaving Trostani no longer one being.
